sources: Frontiers, 3-piece set skill passive_equipsuit_combosuit_01 (rmxlinux Json/SkillData, game 1.6; SkillPatchTable L1: comboskill_cooldown 0.85, dmg_up 0.16, duration 15): cardAttributeModifier attr 47 (ComboSkillCooldownScalar) formulaItem 8 comboskill_cooldown is on the stat panel, and combo cooldowns read it (batch-2 S2). buff_equipsuit_combosuit_01: abilityEvent 142 + CheckObtainAtbType method [0] (natural SP) type [3] (from a skill): when the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team (CharacterTeamFinder) gets buff_equipsuit_combosuit_01_adddamage: DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone dmg_up (all DMG) for `duration`, stackingType 2 max 1 (refreshed: "This effect cannot stack").

The sp event carries the grant's kind from the data (atbGainMethod; batch-2 V3), so the trigger takes natural SP from the wearer's skills of any kind: battle-skill refunds (method 1: the Endministrators', Laevatain's, Catcher's, Typhoeus's, Liino's, Estella's, Liino's combo refund) don't trigger it; Akekuri's, Antal's and Camille's combo and ultimate SP (method 0, type 3) do. Basic attacks' SP is natural too but not from a skill: the kinds leave basic out.
